data.name: Vikasith
data.gender_notes: Vikasith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vikasith is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'Vikas' meaning progress, growth, development and 'Iti' meaning that, this. This name signifies the one who brings progress, growth, and development to his surroundings and is dedicated to the path of wisdom, courage, and strength. It is an apt name for a child who is destined to make a significant impact in the world.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vikasith is a spiritual name that signifies the journey of self-discovery and personal growth. It is believed that the name carries the energy of the divine teacher who guides the individual on his spiritual path and helps him overcome challenges and obstacles. The name resonates with the vibrations of wisdom, courage, and strength and inspires the bearer to lead a virtuous and purposeful life.
data.etymology: Vikasith belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Progress, growth, development.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vikasith total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
